description: Every table in the PDF becomes a sheet, and every figure arrives as a number you can actually add up. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

data.description: The PDF to read, base64-encoded (a data: URL prefix is accepted). It needs a text layer: a scan with no text is refused with `no_text` rather than returning an empty workbook. Refused above 25 MB decoded.

includeText.description: Also keep everything that was not in a table — headings and paragraphs, in reading order, with the page each came from — as a sheet of its own. On by default: on an invoice the total being charged is a line of prose above the tables rather than a row inside one, so a workbook of only the grids has lost the number the document is about.

joinPages.description: Treat a table that carries on over a page break as one table, dropping the repeated heading row. On by default, because a statement split across twelve pages is one table; turn it off to get one sheet per page.

sheetName.description: What to call a tab the document did not name — `Table` gives Table 1, Table 2. A table the document headed keeps its own heading instead, trimmed to what Excel allows and made unique if it has to be.

name: pdf_to_excel
title: PDF to Excel
